verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents an Automations feature that schedules prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal pipeline without the user present. Its Computer ecosystem adds scheduled tasks such as running tests every weekday and reporting failures. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work reliably, and evidence of non-schedule (event-driven) triggers and of run monitoring or failure handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline
Schedule a task that runs the test suite every weekday at 9 and reports failures with the error output.
Run a prompt on a schedule: "run the tests every weekday at 9", "summarize new files every Monday", "check the deploy hourly".
